content:
nicole.sales: MantleCare POC kickoff. They saw p99 spikes and occasional 502s at ~110 qps. Need short runbook, hosted vs dedicated ballpark, and security snippet for KMS/audit. Can ops run a focused benchmark tomorrow 09:30 PT?

devin.perf: can do. quick clarifying Qs: model (we suggested rwd-chat-3b), average tokens (they said ~400 avg, 15% >1500), streaming off. agree on reproduce -> config sweep -> mitigation.

sre-li: ops note: we'll need their firewall allowlist for generator IPs and a consented sanitized sample set. also Private/VPC adds ~4-6ms to RTT.

devin.perf: short runbook:
- step 1 baseline (10m): steady 40/80/110 qps, capture p50/p95/p99 + error rates
- step 2 burst (3m bursts): 110 -> 200 over 45s, hold 3m, cooldown 3m
- step 3 configs: prefix KV cache on/off, batching window 15/30ms, quantized fallback for long seqs
- metrics: tokens/s, GPU util, queue depth, p50/p95/p99, 5xx traces

nicole.sales: procurement asks rough numbers now: hosted vs dedicated for sustained ~110 qps.

devin.perf: quick ballpark: hosted usage ~ $5k/mo for rwd-chat-3b at that mix. Dedicated (small reserved pool + support) ~ $7k-10k/mo depending on SLA and audit add-ons. Dedicated recommended for strict burst SLAs.

sec-team: security snippet: KMS supported for Dedicated/Private (BYOK). Hosted uses envelope encryption; enterprise-level KMS available on request. Audit logs exportable to SIEM for Dedicated/Private; hosted gives aggregated logs.

deploy-bot: deploy complete: rwd-chat-3b@staging-0f9a deployed, perf hooks enabled.

sre-li: who owns tomorrow 09:30 PT run? I'll handle infra and allowlist.

devin.perf: I'll run load and create dashboard (p50/p95/p99, queue depth, tokens/s).

nicole.sales: I'll lock the calendar with MantleCare and include the pricing anchor + security snippet. Thanks team :thumbsup:
